annotations.title: Text chunker for RAG and embeddings

description: Text chunker for RAG and embeddings — Split long text (URL-encoded; roughly 12,000 chars fits in a GET URL, hard cap 30,000) into model-sized chunks for embeddings, RAG or long-document prompts. Breaks on paragraph, then sentence, then word boundaries; size = target tokens per chunk (default 400), overlap = shared tokens between chunks (default 10%), by = auto|paragraph|sentence|word. Each chunk is an exact substring with character offsets and an estimated token count. Offline and instant. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
